headline: GPT-6.1 Sol, MiMo V2 Pro and Flash, two decision models, and -latest aliases
share: GPT-6.1 Sol, MiMo V2 Pro, MiMo V2 Flash, Liquid d1 and Solar Decide are new on AnyRouter. Also new: -latest aliases such as anthropic/claude-sonnet-latest, one per model family, that always point at the newest model in it.
rationale: The catalog diff lists 37 added ids, but 14 were already filmed in 001-003 and 18 of the other 23 are -latest aliases, not models. The film leads with the five real new models and shows the aliases as a ledger of what each one follows, with no prices.
